notes.subject: יקבהו
notes.rationale: Aẓar קבב 'ad iḥerṛem / ad yenni tiḥerṛma ɣef' — kra n yimsuqlen ɛerḍen-as 'ad t-icemmen', maca anamek amezwaru d tiḥerṛma.

notes.subject: d taf
notes.rationale: Taɛbranit ur tesi ara awal n usuddem, taqbaylit tesra-t iwakken ad tfhem talɣa.

notes.subject: iddigen (i wass n wenmazal)
notes.rationale: Gloss n משביר tettawsi-d-ddeffir n wawal 'iddigen' i d-yeffɣen deg tgejdit tamezwarut, axaṭer taqbaylit tessutur talɣa tamezwarut n wemdan.

translation: Win iḥebbisen iddigen, leǧmaɛ ad t-iḥerṛem, ma d tabarkt ad tili ⟨d⟩ ⟨taf⟩ ɣef uqerru n win yettazen iddigen.
